exam.name: NEET
exam.description: Official National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET UG) 2026 Syllabus approved by the National Medical Commission (NMC).

concepts.name: Units of Measurement & SI System
concepts.description: Units of measurements, System of Units, SI Units, fundamental and derived units, least count, significant figures.

concepts.name: Significant Figures & Errors in Measurement
concepts.description: Least count, significant figures, errors in measurements, absolute error, relative error, percentage error.

concepts.name: Dimensional Analysis & Applications
concepts.description: Dimensions of physical quantities, dimensional analysis and its applications in checking homogeneity and deriving formulas.

concepts.name: Motion in a Straight Line & Kinematic Graphs
concepts.description: Frame of reference, motion in a straight line, position-time graph, speed and velocity, uniform and non-uniform motion, average speed and instantaneous velocity, uniformly accelerated motion, velocity-time and position-time graphs, kinematic equations.

concepts.name: Scalars, Vectors & Vector Operations
concepts.description: Scalars and vectors, vector addition and subtraction, scalar (dot) and vector (cross) products, unit vector, resolution of a vector.

concepts.name: Relative Velocity & Projectile Motion
concepts.description: Relative velocity in 1D and 2D, motion in a plane, projectile motion trajectory, time of flight, horizontal range, maximum height, uniform circular motion.

concepts.name: Newton’s Laws of Motion & Momentum
concepts.description: Force and inertia, Newton’s first law of motion, momentum, Newton’s second law, impulse, Newton’s third law. Law of conservation of linear momentum and applications. Equilibrium of concurrent forces.

concepts.name: Static, Kinetic & Rolling Friction
concepts.description: Static and kinetic friction, laws of friction, rolling friction, coefficient of friction, motion on rough horizontal and inclined planes.

concepts.name: Dynamics of Circular Motion & Banked Roads
concepts.description: Dynamics of uniform circular motion: centripetal force and applications: vehicle on a level circular road, vehicle on a banked road.

concepts.name: Work-Energy Theorem & Spring Potential
concepts.description: Work done by constant and variable force, kinetic and potential energy, work-energy theorem, power, potential energy of spring, conservation of mechanical energy, conservative/non-conservative forces, motion in vertical circle.

concepts.name: Elastic & Inelastic Collisions
concepts.description: Elastic and inelastic collisions in one and two dimensions, coefficient of restitution.

subtopics.name: Center of Mass & Rigid Body Dynamics

concepts.name: Center of Mass & Torque
concepts.description: Center of mass of two-particle system and rigid body. Basic concepts of rotational motion, moment of force, torque, angular momentum and conservation.

concepts.name: Moment of Inertia & Axis Theorems
concepts.description: Moment of inertia, radius of gyration, moments of inertia for simple geometrical objects, parallel and perpendicular axes theorems, rigid body rotation equations, linear vs rotational motion.

concepts.name: Universal Gravitation & Acceleration due to Gravity
concepts.description: Universal law of gravitation, variation of g with altitude and depth, Kepler’s laws of planetary motion.

concepts.name: Gravitational Potential & Satellite Motion
concepts.description: Gravitational potential energy, gravitational potential, escape velocity, orbital velocity, time period and total energy of satellite.

concepts.name: Elasticity & Hooke’s Law
concepts.description: Elastic behavior, stress-strain relationship, Hooke’s law, Young’s modulus, bulk modulus, modulus of rigidity.

concepts.name: Fluid Statics, Viscosity & Bernoulli’s Principle
concepts.description: Fluid column pressure, Pascal’s law, viscosity, Stokes’ law, terminal velocity, streamline/turbulent flow, critical velocity, Bernoulli’s principle.

concepts.name: Surface Tension & Calorimetry
concepts.description: Surface energy, surface tension, angle of contact, excess pressure, capillary rise. Heat, temperature, thermal expansion, specific heat capacity, calorimetry, latent heat, conduction, convection, radiation.

concepts.name: Zeroth & First Laws of Thermodynamics
concepts.description: Thermal equilibrium, zeroth law, temperature concept, heat, work, internal energy, first law, isothermal and adiabatic processes.

concepts.name: Second Law of Thermodynamics
concepts.description: Second law of thermodynamics, reversible and irreversible processes.

concepts.name: Ideal Gas State & RMS Speed
concepts.description: Equation of state of perfect gas, compression work, kinetic theory assumptions, pressure concept, RMS speed of gas molecules.

concepts.name: Degrees of Freedom & Mean Free Path
concepts.description: Degrees of freedom, law of equipartition of energy, specific heat capacities of gases, mean free path, Avogadro’s number.

concepts.name: Simple Harmonic Motion (SHM)
concepts.description: Periodic motion, time period, frequency, displacement, SHM equation, phase, spring oscillations, kinetic and potential energy, simple pendulum derivation.

concepts.name: Wave Motion, Standing Waves & Beats
concepts.description: Transverse and longitudinal waves, speed of travelling wave, progressive wave equation, superposition principle, standing waves in strings/organ pipes, beats.

concepts.name: Electric Charge & Field Dipole
concepts.description: Charge conservation, Coulomb’s law, superposition principle, continuous charge distribution, electric field lines, electric dipole torque in uniform field.

concepts.name: Gauss’s Law Applications
concepts.description: Electric flux, Gauss’s law and applications (infinite wire, plane sheet, thin spherical shell).

concepts.name: Electric Potential & Capacitors
concepts.description: Electric potential and potential difference, equipotential surfaces, potential energy, dielectrics, parallel plate capacitor, series/parallel combinations, energy stored.

concepts.name: Drift Velocity & Resistance Trends
concepts.description: Electric current, drift velocity, mobility, Ohm’s law, V-I characteristics, electrical energy and power, resistivity, conductivity, temperature dependence.

concepts.name: Cell EMF & Kirchhoff’s Bridge Circuits
concepts.description: Internal resistance, cell EMF and combinations, Kirchhoff’s laws and applications, Wheatstone bridge, Metre Bridge.

topics.name: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism

concepts.name: Biot-Savart & Ampere’s Law Applications
concepts.description: Biot-Savart law (circular loop), Ampere’s law (straight wire, solenoid), Lorentz force, force on current-carrying conductor, force between parallel wires.

concepts.name: Galvanometer & Magnetic Substances
concepts.description: Torque on magnetic dipole, moving coil galvanometer sensitivity and ammeter/voltmeter conversion. Bar magnet dipole moment, field lines, Para-, Dia-, and Ferromagnetic materials, temperature effects.

concepts.name: Faraday’s Law & Self/Mutual Inductance
concepts.description: Electromagnetic induction, Faraday’s law, induced EMF, Lenz’s law, eddy currents, self and mutual inductance.

concepts.name: AC Circuits, Resonance & Transformers
concepts.description: Alternating currents, peak/RMS values, reactance, impedance, LCR series circuit resonance, power in AC circuits, wattless current, AC generator and transformer.

concepts.name: Displacement Current & EM Spectrum
concepts.description: Displacement current, electromagnetic waves transverse nature, EM spectrum (radio, micro, IR, visible, UV, X-rays, gamma) applications.

concepts.name: Reflection, Refraction & Optical Instruments
concepts.description: Reflection, spherical mirrors, mirror formula, refraction, Snell’s law, total internal reflection, thin lens formula, lens maker formula, magnification, power, prism dispersion, microscope, telescope.

concepts.name: Wave Optics, YDSE & Polarization
concepts.description: Wavefronts, Huygens’ principle, interference, Young’s double-slit experiment fringe width, single slit diffraction, Brewster’s law polarization.

topics.name: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation

concepts.name: Photoelectric Effect & de Broglie Wavelength
concepts.description: Photoelectric effect, Hertz/Lenard observations, Einstein’s photoelectric equation, de Broglie relation for matter waves.

concepts.name: Alpha Scattering & Bohr Hydrogen Model
concepts.description: Rutherford scattering experiment, Bohr model postulates, energy levels, hydrogen spectral series.

concepts.name: Mass Defect & Nuclear Fission/Fusion
concepts.description: Atomic nucleus size, mass defect, binding energy per nucleon curve, nuclear fission and fusion.

concepts.name: Semiconductor Diodes & Rectifiers
concepts.description: Semiconductors, p-n junction diode forward/reverse characteristics, diode rectifier, LED, photodiode, solar cell, Zener diode as voltage regulator.

concepts.name: Logic Gates (AND, OR, NOT, NAND, NOR)
concepts.description: Logic gates (OR, AND, NOT, NAND, NOR) truth tables and digital operations.

concepts.name: Vernier Calipers, Screw Gauge & Pendulum
concepts.description: Vernier calipers diameter/depth measurements, screw gauge wire thickness, simple pendulum energy dissipation, metre scale moments.

concepts.name: Young’s Modulus, Viscosity & Optics Experiments
concepts.description: Young’s modulus, surface tension capillary rise, terminal velocity viscosity, speed of sound resonance tube, specific heat capacity, metre bridge resistivity, Ohm’s law, galvanometer deflection, focal length of mirrors/lenses, prism deviation, diode I-V curves.

topics.name: Physical Chemistry: Basic Concepts & Atomic Structure

concepts.name: Dalton’s Theory, Mole Concept & Stoichiometry
concepts.description: Matter nature, Dalton’s atomic theory, atomic and molecular masses, mole concept, molar mass, percentage composition, empirical and molecular formula, chemical stoichiometry.

concepts.name: Bohr Model, Quantum Numbers & Electronic Configuration
concepts.description: Electromagnetic radiation, photoelectric effect, hydrogen spectrum, Bohr model postulates and radius/energy derivations. De Broglie relation, Heisenberg uncertainty principle, quantum numbers (n, l, m, s), orbital shapes (s, p, d), Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion principle, Hund’s rule, electronic configuration of elements.

concepts.name: Ionic, Covalent & VSEPR Bonding Models
concepts.description: Kossel-Lewis approach, ionic bond lattice enthalpy, electronegativity, Fajan’s rule, dipole moment, VSEPR theory and molecular shapes.

concepts.name: Valence Bond, Hybridization & MO Theory
concepts.description: Valence Bond Theory, hybridization (s, p, d), resonance, Molecular Orbital Theory (LCAO, sigma/pi bonds, bond order, magnetic properties of homonuclear diatomic molecules), hydrogen bonding.

concepts.name: First & Second Laws of Thermodynamics
concepts.description: Thermodynamic systems, processes, state functions, first law, work, heat, internal energy, enthalpy, heat capacity, Hess’s law, bond dissociation/formation enthalpies, second law, entropy (S), Gibbs free energy (G), spontaneity criterion.

concepts.name: Concentration Units, Raoult’s Law & Colligative Properties
concepts.description: Concentration expressions (molarity, molality, mole fraction, mass percent), Raoult’s law, ideal and non-ideal solutions, colligative properties (relative lowering of vapor pressure, elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point, osmotic pressure), van’t Hoff factor.

concepts.name: Chemical Equilibrium & Le Chatelier’s Principle
concepts.description: Dynamic physical and chemical equilibrium, Henry’s law, law of mass action, Kc and Kp constants, delta G relation, Le Chatelier’s principle factors.

concepts.name: Ionic Equilibrium, pH & Buffer Solutions
concepts.description: Arrhenius, Bronsted-Lowry, and Lewis acid-base theories, ionization constants, water dissociation, pH scale, common ion effect, salt hydrolysis, solubility product (Ksp), buffer solutions.

subtopics.name: Redox, Conductance, Nernst Equation & Rate Laws

concepts.name: Redox Reactions & Electrolytic Conductance
concepts.description: Oxidation number rules, balancing redox reactions, electrolytic conductance, molar conductivity concentration dependence, Kohlrausch’s law.

concepts.name: Galvanic Cells, Nernst Equation & Fuel Cells
concepts.description: Galvanic and electrolytic cells, electrode potential, standard hydrogen electrode, Nernst equation, Gibbs free energy and cell EMF, dry cell, lead storage battery, fuel cells.

concepts.name: Reaction Rates, Integrated Rate Equations & Arrhenius Theory
concepts.description: Reaction rates, rate law, order and molecularity, integrated rate equations for zero and first order reactions, half-lives, activation energy, Arrhenius equation, collision theory.

concepts.name: Modern Periodic Table & Periodic Trends
concepts.description: Modern periodic law, s, p, d, f blocks, periodic trends: atomic/ionic radii, ionization enthalpy, electron gain enthalpy, valence, oxidation states.

concepts.name: p-Block Elements (Group 13 to 18)
concepts.description: Group 13 to 18 general electronic configuration, physical/chemical property trends, anomalous properties of first element in each group.

concepts.name: d- and f-Block Transition Elements & Compounds
concepts.description: First-row transition series properties: oxidation states, color, catalytic behavior, magnetism, alloys. Preparation, properties of K2Cr2O7 and KMnO4. Lanthanoids (lanthanoid contraction) and Actinoids electronic configuration.

subtopics.name: Werner’s Theory, IUPAC & Crystal Field Theory

concepts.name: Werner’s Theory, Ligands & IUPAC Nomenclature
concepts.description: Werner’s theory, ligands, coordination number, denticity, chelation, IUPAC nomenclature of mononuclear coordination compounds.

concepts.name: Isomerism, VBT & Crystal Field Splitting (CFT)
concepts.description: Structural and stereoisomerism in coordination complexes. Valence Bond Theory and Crystal Field Theory, d-orbital splitting, color, magnetic properties, biological applications.

concepts.name: Purification Methods & Qualitative/Quantitative Analysis
concepts.description: Crystallization, sublimation, distillation, differential extraction, chromatography. Qualitative detection of N, S, P, halogens (Lassaigne test). Quantitative estimation of C, H, N, S, P, halogens, empirical formula calculations.

concepts.name: General Organic Chemistry (GOC) & Electronic Displacement
concepts.description: Hybridization of carbon, functional group classification, IUPAC nomenclature, homolytic/heterolytic cleavage, carbocations, carbanions, free radicals, electrophiles, nucleophiles. Inductive effect, electromeric effect, resonance, hyperconjugation.

concepts.name: Alkanes, Alkenes, Alkynes & Aromatic Hydrocarbons
concepts.description: Alkanes halogenation mechanism, Newman projections. Alkenes geometrical isomerism, electrophilic addition (Markovnikov & peroxide effect), ozonolysis. Alkynes acidity, addition reactions. Benzene electrophilic aromatic substitution (nitration, halogenation, Friedel-Crafts).

topics.name: Organic Chemistry: Functional Groups (Halogens, Oxygen, Nitrogen)

concepts.name: Haloalkanes & Haloarenes (SN1/SN2)
concepts.description: Preparation methods, C-X bond nature, SN1 and SN2 substitution mechanisms. Environmental effects of chloroform, iodoform, freons, DDT.

concepts.name: Alcohols, Phenols & Ethers
concepts.description: Primary/secondary/tertiary alcohol distinction (Lucas test), dehydration mechanism. Phenol acidity, electrophilic substitutions, Reimer-Tiemann and Kolbe reactions. Williamson ether synthesis.

concepts.name: Aldehydes, Ketones & Carboxylic Acids
concepts.description: Nucleophilic addition to carbonyl group, Grignard additions, Clemmensen and Wolff-Kishner reductions, Aldol condensation, Cannizzaro reaction, haloform test, acid strength.

concepts.name: Amines & Diazonium Salts
concepts.description: Primary, secondary, tertiary amines preparation, basicity order. Diazonium salts preparation and synthetic applications in organic chemistry.

concepts.name: Carbohydrates, Proteins, Vitamins & Nucleic Acids
concepts.description: Glucose/fructose structures, disaccharides (sucrose, lactose, maltose), amino acids, peptide bond, protein primary/secondary/tertiary structures, denaturation, enzymes, vitamins, DNA/RNA chemical structures.

concepts.name: Practical Chemistry Principles (Salt Analysis & Titrations)
concepts.description: Functional group detection (alcoholic, phenolic, aldehyde, ketone, carboxyl, amino). Organic/inorganic preparations (Mohr’s salt, potash alum, acetanilide). Titrations (KMnO4 vs oxalic acid/Mohr salt). Qualitative salt analysis of cations and anions.

concepts.name: Biodiversity, Taxonomy & Binomial Nomenclature
concepts.description: What is living, biodiversity, taxonomy, systematics, species concept, taxonomic hierarchy, binomial nomenclature.

concepts.name: Five Kingdom System (Monera, Protista, Fungi, Viruses)
concepts.description: Five kingdom classification (Whittaker), salient features of Monera, Protista, Fungi, Lichens, Viruses, Viroids.

concepts.name: Plant Kingdom Classification (Algae to Angiosperms)
concepts.description: Salient features and classification of Algae, Bryophytes, Pteridophytes, Gymnosperms, Angiosperms with examples.

concepts.name: Animal Kingdom Classification (Non-Chordates & Chordates)
concepts.description: Salient features and classification of non-chordate phyla and chordate classes with examples.

topics.name: Structural Organisation in Animals and Plants

subtopics.name: Plant Morphology, Plant Families & Animal Anatomy (Frog)

concepts.name: Plant Morphology, Anatomy & Plant Families
concepts.description: Morphology and anatomy of root, stem, leaf, inflorescence (cymose/racemose), flower, fruit, seed. Plant families: Malvaceae, Cruciferae, Leguminosae, Compositae, Gramineae.

concepts.name: Animal Tissues & Anatomy of Frog
concepts.description: Animal tissue types. Morphology, anatomy, and system functions (digestive, circulatory, respiratory, nervous, reproductive) of Frog.

concepts.name: Cell Theory & Organelle Structure
concepts.description: Cell theory, prokaryotic vs eukaryotic cells, cell membrane, cell wall, endomembrane system (ER, Golgi, lysosomes, vacuoles), mitochondria, ribosomes, plastids, cytoskeleton, cilia, flagella, centrioles, nucleus, chromatin.

concepts.name: Biomolecules & Enzyme Kinetics
concepts.description: Proteins, carbohydrates, lipids, nucleic acids structures and functions. Enzyme classification, properties, mechanism of action.

concepts.name: Cell Cycle, Mitosis & Meiosis
concepts.description: Cell cycle phases, mitosis, meiosis stages and evolutionary significance.

concepts.name: Photosynthesis (Light Phase, C3/C4 Pathways)
concepts.description: Site of photosynthesis, pigments, light reaction, cyclic/non-cyclic photophosphorylation, chemiosmotic hypothesis, C3 Calvin cycle, C4 Hatch-Slack pathway, photorespiration.

concepts.name: Cellular Respiration & Energy Relations
concepts.description: Glycolysis, fermentation, TCA cycle, electron transport system (ETS), ATP yield, amphibolic pathways, respiratory quotient (RQ).

concepts.name: Plant Growth Regulators & Development
concepts.description: Seed germination, plant growth phases, differentiation, dedifferentiation, redifferentiation. Auxin, gibberellin, cytokinin, ethylene, ABA functions.

subtopics.name: Respiration, Circulation, Excretion, Locomotion & Neural/Endocrine Controls

concepts.name: Breathing, Gas Exchange & Respiratory Volumes
concepts.description: Human respiratory system, breathing mechanism, gas transport (O2-hemoglobin dissociation), respiratory volumes, asthma, emphysema.

concepts.name: Blood Composition, Heart & Cardiac Cycle
concepts.description: Blood composition, groups, clotting, lymph. Heart anatomy, cardiac cycle, ECG, double circulation, hypertension, CAD.

concepts.name: Excretory System, Urine Formation & Dialysis
concepts.description: Ammonotelism/ureotelism/uricotelism, nephron structure, urine formation, RAAS/ADH regulation, uraemia, renal failure, dialysis.

concepts.name: Locomotion, Muscle Contraction & Skeletal Disorders
concepts.description: Ciliary/flagellar/muscular movement, actin/myosin muscle contraction mechanism, joints, myasthenia gravis, osteoporosis, gout.

concepts.name: Neural Impulse Conduction & Central Nervous System
concepts.description: Neuron structure, nerve impulse action potential generation and synaptic transmission, CNS, PNS, ANS.

concepts.name: Endocrine Glands, Hormones & Metabolic Disorders
concepts.description: Hypothalamus, pituitary, thyroid, adrenal, pancreas, gonads hormones, hormone action mechanism, dwarfism, cretinism, diabetes, Addison’s disease.

concepts.name: Sexual Reproduction in Flowering Plants
concepts.description: Gametophyte development, pollination, outbreeding, pollen-pistil interaction, double fertilization, endosperm/embryo development, apomixis, polyembryony.

concepts.name: Human Reproductive Systems & Embryogenesis
concepts.description: Male/female reproductive systems, spermatogenesis, oogenesis, menstrual cycle, fertilization, blastocyst implantation, pregnancy, placenta, lactation.

concepts.name: Reproductive Health, Contraception & ART (IVF, ZIFT)
concepts.description: STD prevention, birth control methods, contraception, MTP, amniocentesis, infertility ART (IVF, ZIFT, GIFT).

subtopics.name: Mendelism, DNA Molecular Basis & Evolutionary Theories

concepts.name: Mendelian Genetics, Linkage & Genetic Disorders
concepts.description: Mendelian laws, incomplete dominance, codominance, blood groups, linkage, sex determination, hemophilia, color blindness, thalassemia, Down/Turner/Klinefelter syndromes.

concepts.name: Molecular Basis of Inheritance (DNA, Transcription, Translation, Lac Operon)
concepts.description: DNA/RNA structure, replication, Central Dogma, transcription, genetic code, translation, Lac Operon regulation, HGP, DNA fingerprinting.

concepts.name: Evolution, Darwinism & Hardy-Weinberg Law
concepts.description: Origin of life, biological evolution evidence, Darwinism, natural selection, gene flow, genetic drift, Hardy-Weinberg principle, adaptive radiation, human evolution.

concepts.name: Pathogens, Human Diseases & Immunology
concepts.description: Malaria, filariasis, typhoid, pneumonia, amoebiasis, ringworm, dengue, chikungunya. Immunity, vaccines, HIV/AIDS, cancer, drug abuse.

concepts.name: Microbes in Food Processing, Sewage & Biofertilizers
concepts.description: Microbes in household food processing, industrial production, sewage treatment, biogas energy, biocontrol agents, biofertilizers.

subtopics.name: rDNA Technology, Insulin, Bt Crops & Biosafety

concepts.name: Recombinant DNA Technology Principles & Tools
concepts.description: Genetic engineering tools: restriction enzymes, vectors, competent host, PCR, rDNA technology steps.

concepts.name: Biotech Applications in Health, Agriculture & Biosafety
concepts.description: Human insulin, gene therapy, GM Bt crops, transgenic animals, biosafety issues, biopiracy, patents.

concepts.name: Population Interactions & Growth Attributes
concepts.description: Organism-environment interactions: mutualism, competition, predation, parasitism. Birth/death rates, age distribution.

concepts.name: Ecosystem Energy Flow & Pyramids
concepts.description: Ecosystem productivity, decomposition, energy flow, pyramids of number, biomass, energy.

concepts.name: Biodiversity Loss, Hotspots & Conservation (Red Data Book)
concepts.description: Biodiversity patterns, importance, loss causes, conservation (in-situ, ex-situ), hotspots, Red Data Book, sanctuaries, sacred groves.
